service.method: UPDATE SSIAD SET SMR_STATUS = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SMR_STATUS } , SMR_STATUS ) , ADD_DATE = #DB_OWNER#nvl($S{ADD_DATE } , ADD_DATE ) , CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE} , CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME} , CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} , DEL_FLAG = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${DEL_FLAG } , DEL_FLAG ) , APPLY_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${APPLY_TYPE } , APPLY_TYPE ) , SUBJECT = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SUBJECT } , SUBJECT ) , RE_FLAG = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${RE_FLAG } , RE_FLAG ) , RE_DETAIL = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${RE_DETAIL } , RE_DETAIL ) , REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE} , REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE) , SUBMISSION_PLACE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SUBMISSION_PLACE } , SUBMISSION_PLACE ) , EXPLANATION = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${EXPLANATION } , EXPLANATION ) , REMARK = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${REMARK } , REMARK ) , RCPT_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${RCPT_TYPE } , RCPT_TYPE ) , RCPT_REMARK = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${RCPT_REMARK } , RCPT_REMARK ) , CONFIRM_DATE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONFIRM_DATE } , CONFIRM_DATE ) , CONFIRM_TIME = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONFIRM_TIME } , CONFIRM_TIME ) , CONFIRM_USER_ID = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONFIRM_USER_ID } , CONFIRM_USER_ID ) , SUBMIT_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SUBMIT_TYPE } , SUBMIT_TYPE ) , SUBMIT_REMARK = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SUBMIT_REMARK } , SUBMIT_REMARK ) , LEGAL_WATERMARK = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${LEGAL_WATERMARK } , LEGAL_WATERMARK ) , REJECT_REASON = #DB_OWNER#nvl($S{ACCEPT_REASON } , REJECT_REASON ) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , ITEM_NO , ITEM_CODE , ITEM_SEQ , ITEM_NAME , ITEM_TYPE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , SYSTEM , CLASS , METHOD , DISPLAY_TEMPLATE , DISPLAY_EDIT , DEL_FLAG , SEAL_WIDTH , SEAL_HEIGHT FROM SUPIM WHERE #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND CONT_TYPE = 'S' AND CATEGORY = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CATEGORY}, 'COMMON') ORDER BY ITEM_CODE ,ITEM_SEQ ASC

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , APRV_NUMBER , APRV_SEQ , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , DEL_FLAG , SUBJECT , REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE , DRAFT_USER_ID , DRAFT_USER_NAME , DRAFT_USER_DEPT_CODE , DRAFT_USER_DEPT_NAME , DRAFT_DATE , DRAFT_TIME , CONFIRM_USER_ID , CONFIRM_USER_NAME , CONFIRM_USER_DEPT_CODE , CONFIRM_USER_DEPT_NAME , CONFIRM_DATE , CONFIRM_TIME , SUBMISSION_PLACE , REMARK , RCPT_TYPE , SUBMIT_TYPE FROM SSIAD_GW WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND APRV_NUMBER = $S{APRV_NUMBER} AND (SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR ADD_USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%')) AND ADD_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND ADD_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} ORDER BY APRV_NUMBER DESC

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , APRV_NUMBER , APRV_SEQ , DOC_NO , DOC_SUBJECT , SEAL_TYPE , COUNT , PRINT_COUNT , DOWN_COUNT , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , DEL_FLAG FROM SSIPD_GW WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND APRV_NUMBER = ${APRV_NUMBER} AND APRV_SEQ = $S{APRV_SEQ}

SELECT SETL.SMR_NUMBER, SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME, SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER , SEDC.SEAL_MG_USER_ID, SEDC.SEAL_MG_SUBJECT FROM SSETL SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SSEDC SEDC ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = SEDC.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = SEDC.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = SEDC.SMR_NUMBER WHERE ( ( ( CONCAT( ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME} ) BETWEEN CONCAT(EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME) AND CONCAT(EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME) ) OR ( CONCAT( ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME} ) BETWEEN CONCAT(EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME) AND CONCAT(EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME) ) ) OR ( ( CONCAT(EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME) BETWEEN CONCAT(${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}) AND CONCAT(${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}) ) OR ( CONCAT(EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME) BETWEEN CONCAT(${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}) AND CONCAT(${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}) ) ) ) AND SMR_STATUS IN ('RW','RR') AND SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER = ${MANAGE_NUMBER}
SELECT ELECTRON_FLAG , REAL_FLAG FROM SSEAL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SEAL_TYPE = 'C' AND DEL_FLAG = 'N'

SELECT SISD.SMR_NUMBER, SISD.SD_NUMBER, SIAD.SMR_STATUS, SIAD.SUBJECT, SIAD.APPLY_TYPE, SISD.ADD_DATE, SIAD.RE_DETAIL, SIAD.RE_FLAG, SIAD.REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE, SIAD.SUBMISSION_PLACE, SISD.SMI_NUMBER, SISD.CONTENTS, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO = (SISD.ATTACH_NO) AND DOC_SEQ != '' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') <> 'Y' ) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ATTACH_FLAG FROM SSISD SISD LEFT OUTER JOIN SSIAD SIAD ON SISD.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND SISD.COMPANY_CODE = SIAD.COMPANY_CODE AND SISD.SMR_NUMBER = SIAD.SMR_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN SSRAD SRAD ON SRAD.HOUSE_CODE = SISD.HOUSE_CODE AND SRAD.COMPANY_CODE = SISD.COMPANY_CODE AND SRAD.SMI_NUMBER = SISD.SMI_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN SFILE A ON A.HOUSE_CODE= SISD.HOUSE_CODE AND A.DOC_NO = SISD.ATTACH_NO WHERE SISD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SISD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND (A.DOC_SEQ IN ('','1') OR A.DOC_SEQ IS NULL) AND SRAD.ELEC_DOC_FLAG ='1' AND (1=1 AND SISD.SMR_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SIAD.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SIAD.SUBMISSION_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SISD.CONTENTS LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') ) AND SISD.ADD_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SISD.ADD_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} AND SIAD.RE_FLAG = $S{RE_FLAG} AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS = 'C' AND SISD.REAL_DOC_CHK <> '1'
AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO = SISD.ATTACH_NO AND DOC_SEQ != '' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') <> 'Y' ) = 0
ORDER BY SMR_NUMBER DESC, SD_NUMBER ASC

SELECT BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID FROM SBALN BALN LEFT OUTER JOIN SBAGL BAGL ON BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = BALN.COMPANY_CODE AND BAGL.CTRL_CODE = BALN.CTRL_CODE WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE =${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.CTRL_CODE ='SEAL_CONFIRM'

SELECT A.DOC_NO, A.DOC_SEQ, A.TYPE, A.DES_FILE_NAME, A.SRC_FILE_NAME, A.FILE_SIZE FROM SSRAD SRAD LEFT OUTER JOIN SFILE A ON SRAD.HOUSE_CODE = A.HOUSE_CODE AND SRAD.ATTACH_NO = A.DOC_NO WHERE SRAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SRAD.SMI_NUMBER = ${SMI_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(A.DEL_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , DOC_TYPE , DOC_NUMBER , DOC_SEQ , ADD_USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , DEL_FLAG , CODE , EXPIRE_DATE , EXTRA_PARAM FROM ULNMA WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , CODE , PRIVATE_CODE , USER_COMPANY_CODE , USER_ID , ADD_USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , DEL_FLAG , ACCESS_KEY , EXTRA_PARAM FROM ULNUS WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND EXTRA_PARAM LIKE '%'+${SMR_NUMBER}+'%'

SELECT SIAD.ADD_USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID , CASE WHEN USMT.LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN USMT.USER_NAME_LOC ELSE USMT.USER_NAME_ENG END AS APP_USER_NAME , USMT.LANGUAGE , GWGL.APP_NO , GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ FROM SSIAD SIAD LEFT JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SIAD.ADD_USER_ID LEFT JOIN SGWGL GWGL ON GWGL.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = SIAD.COMPANY_CODE AND GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 = SIAD.SMR_NUMBER WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT SETL.SMR_NUMBER, SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME, SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER , SEDC.SEAL_MG_DEPT, SEDC.SEAL_MG_USER_ID, SEDC.SEAL_MG_SUBJECT, SETL.SMR_STATUS FROM SSETL SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SSEDC SEDC ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = SEDC.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = SEDC.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = SEDC.SMR_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN SSEDC_SEAL DCSL ON SEDC.HOUSE_CODE = DCSL.HOUSE_CODE AND SEDC.COMPANY_CODE = DCSL.COMPANY_CODE AND SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER = DCSL.MANAGE_NUMBER AND SEDC.SMR_NUMBER = DCSL.SMR_NUMBER AND SEDC.SMD_NUMBER = DCSL.SMD_NUMBER WHERE DCSL.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'N' AND SETL.SMR_STATUS IN ('RW','RR','I','W') AND SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER = ${MANAGE_NUMBER} AND SETL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE}

SELECT FI.FILE_NAME_CLIENT , FI.FILE_NAME_SERVER , FI.LAYER , FI.DOC_NUMBER , FI.FILE_ID , PD.SMD_NUMBER FROM SFMFI FI JOIN SSIPD PD ON FI.HOUSE_CODE = PD.HOUSE_CODE AND FI.COMPANY_CODE = PD.COMPANY_CODE AND FI.DOC_NUMBER = PD.SMR_NUMBER+'_'+PD.SMD_NUMBER AND NVL(PD.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' WHERE FI.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND FI.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND FI.DOC_NUMBER LIKE ${SMR_NUMBER} + '%'
SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,LAYER ,ID ,`KEY` ,VALUE FROM SFMMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND ID = ${FILE_ID}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,SMR_NUMBER ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,DATA FROM SSIAD_EXTRA_INFO WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = $S{SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SMI_NUMBER , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , SORT_SEQ , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , SUBJECT , CONTENT , DOC_TYPE , START_DATE , END_DATE , ATTACH_NO , USE_FLAG , REAL_DOC_FLAG , ELEC_DOC_FLAG , START_DATE , END_DATE , TEMPLATE_FORM FROM SSRAD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMI_NUMBER = $S{SMI_NUMBER} AND DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND ( 1=1 AND ${current.DATE} >= START_DATE AND ${current.DATE} <= END_DATE ) AND SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') ORDER BY SORT_SEQ ASC
SELECT UDGL.USE_NUMBER , UDGL.SUBJECT FROM SUDGL UDGL WHERE UDGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND UDGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( UDGL.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,DOC_NO ,DOC_SEQ ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,TYPE ,DES_FILE_NAME ,SRC_FILE_NAME ,FILE_SIZE ,DEL_FLAG ,MOBILE_DOC_NO ,ROOT_PATH FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO = ${ATTACH_NO} AND DOC_SEQ = $S{ATTACH_SEQ}

WITH TOTAL_SSAID AS ( SELECT #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS DEPT ,CASE WHEN APPLY_TYPE ='C' THEN '법인인감' WHEN APPLY_TYPE ='U' THEN '사용인감' WHEN APPLY_TYPE ='D' THEN '증명서' END AS APPLY_SEAL ,CONCAT( RE_FLAG , SMR_STATUS ) AS SIAD_STAT ,COUNT(1) AS COUNT FROM SSIAD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND ADD_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND ADD_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} AND APPLY_TYPE IN ($INS{F_APPLY_TYPE}) GROUP BY DEPT , APPLY_SEAL, RE_FLAG, SMR_STATUS ORDER BY DEPT , APPLY_SEAL, RE_FLAG, SMR_STATUS ) SELECT -- ( CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() over(partition by dept order by APPLY_TYPE ) = 1 then dept else '' END ) as DEPT_NAME dept as dept_name , APPLY_SEAL ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'EC' THEN COUNT END ) AS COMPLETE_E ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'RC' THEN COUNT END ) AS COMPLETE_R ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'EG' THEN COUNT END ) AS MGR_APR_E ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'RG' THEN COUNT END ) AS MGR_APR_R ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'EI' THEN COUNT END ) AS APPROVAL_E ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'RI' THEN COUNT END ) AS APPROVAL_R ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'EN' THEN COUNT END ) AS MGR_REJ_E ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'RN' THEN COUNT END ) AS MGR_REJ_R ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'ER' THEN COUNT END ) AS APR_REJ_E ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'RR' THEN COUNT END ) AS APR_REJ_R ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'ET' THEN COUNT END ) AS TEMP_SAVE_E ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'RT' THEN COUNT END ) AS TEMP_SAVE_R ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'C' THEN COUNT END ) AS D_ISSUE_F ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'CE' THEN COUNT END ) AS D_APR_F ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'I' THEN COUNT END ) AS D_APR_ING ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'R' THEN COUNT END ) AS D_APR_REJ ,SUM( CASE WHEN SIAD_STAT = 'T' THEN COUNT END ) AS D_TEMP_SAVE FROM TOTAL_SSAID WHERE ( 1=1 AND DEPT LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' ) GROUP BY DEPT , APPLY_SEAL ORDER BY DEPT , APPLY_SEAL

SELECT SIAD.HOUSE_CODE, SIAD.COMPANY_CODE, SIAD.SMR_NUMBER, SIAD.ADD_USER_ID, SIPD.SMD_NUMBER, SIPD_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER, SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID, USMT.EMAIL, USMT.USER_NAME_LOC FROM SSIAD SIAD INNER JOIN SSIPD AS SIPD ON SIPD.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND SIPD.SMR_NUMBER = SIAD.SMR_NUMBER INNER JOIN SSIPD_SEAL AS SIPD_SEAL ON SIPD_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND SIPD_SEAL.SMR_NUMBER = SIAD.SMR_NUMBER AND SIPD_SEAL.SMD_NUMBER = SIPD.SMD_NUMBER INNER JOIN SSEAL AS SEAL ON SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = SIPD_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER INNER JOIN SUSMT AS USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUM}

SELECT SIAD.HOUSE_CODE, SIAD.ADD_USER_ID, USMT.USER_NAME_LOC, USMT.EMAIL FROM SSIAD AS SIAD INNER JOIN SUSMT AS USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SIAD.ADD_USER_ID WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUM}
